name: @oge-ui/react-kanban
description: React Kanban board from the OGE UI suite: columns and swimlanes over a plain card array with field mapping, WIP limits, per-column virtualization, drag & drop with Escape-cancel and edge auto-scroll, Ctrl+Arrow keyboard card moving with live announcements, cancelable CRUD and move events, a built-in edit dialog, context menu and toolbar — running the same engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular Kanban package. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
